observation.command:
cat > /workspace/docker-compose.noresources.yml <<'EOF'
# Local environment workaround (not part of the upstream repo):
# this sandbox's cgroup-namespace root is in cgroup-v2 "threaded" mode, so
# runc cannot apply per-container memory limits (deploy.resources.limits).
# runc create succeeds only when no cgroup limits need to be written.
# Verified: `docker run --rm busybox true` OK, `docker run --rm --memory 1g ...`
# fails with: cannot enter cgroupv2 ... with domain controllers -- it is in
# threaded mode. This override strips the memory ceilings only.
services:
  web:
    deploy: !reset null
  hocuspocus:
    deploy: !reset null
  mongo:
    deploy: !reset null
  mailpit:
    deploy: !reset null
EOF
cd /workspace && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.noresources.yml config --services 2>&1 && echo "config OK"
